builds.name: Easy levelling
builds.suits: A big two-handed weapon, Charge to start every fight and Mortal Strike at 40. Simple, sturdy, and it works with whatever weapon drops.
builds.gear: Strength first, then Stamina. A two-handed weapon is best, and wear the heaviest armor you can.

why.Improved Rend: Rend's bleed does more damage, and it opens Deep Wounds.
why.Improved Charge: Charge gives more Rage, so every fight starts with a hit ready.
why.Improved Tactical Mastery: You keep more Rage when you change stance.
why.Anger Management: A steady trickle of Rage in every fight.
why.Deep Wounds: Your critical strikes make the enemy bleed.
why.Two-Handed Weapon Specialization: More damage with a two-handed weapon.
why.Sweeping Strikes: Your next attacks also hit a second enemy.
why.Weaponmaster: A bonus that depends on your weapon, such as more crits with an axe.
why.Bloodthrill: Hitting an enemy that has your Rend on it can make Overpower usable.
why.Mortal Strike: Your big attack from level 40. It also cuts how much the enemy can be healed.
why.Cruelty: More critical strikes with every attack.
why.Unbridled Wrath: Your hits sometimes give extra Rage.
why.Enrage: After you are hit, you often deal more damage for a while.
why.Reckless Swings: A button for a burst of extra Rage.
why.Piercing Howl: Slows every enemy near you, so you can get away.
why.Blood Craze: Heals you a little after a heavy hit.

fight: Charge in, put Rend on the enemy, then spend Rage on Heroic Strike.
Overpower (level 12) works only right after an enemy dodges. Press it then: it is cheap and strong.
Execute (level 24) finishes an enemy that has 20% Health or less.
Two enemies on you? Sweeping Strikes makes your attacks hit both.
Use Mortal Strike every time it is ready.
Losing a fight? Piercing Howl slows them all; then run.

builds.name: Dungeon tank
builds.suits: Hold the enemies' attention in a dungeon with a shield, and take the hits while your group does the damage.
builds.gear: Stamina and Armor first, then Strength. A shield and a one-handed weapon, and the heaviest armor you can wear.

why.Shield Specialization: You block more often, and each block gives you Rage.
why.Anticipation: More Defense, so enemies hit you less often.
why.Defiance: With a shield in Defensive Stance, enemies pay even more attention to you.
why.Last Stand: A button that gives you extra Health for a short time.
why.Improved Sunder Armor: Sunder Armor costs less Rage, so you can use it more.
why.Improved Shield Bash: Shield Bash also stops the enemy from casting spells for a while.
why.Concussion Blow: Stuns an enemy for a short time, and it opens Shield Slam.
why.Improved Shield Wall: Shield Wall, a big cut in damage you take, is ready again sooner.
why.Iron Will: Stuns and Fear effects on you wear off a little sooner.
why.Bastion: You deal more damage while you hold a shield.
why.Shield Slam: A strong shield attack that keeps enemies on you.
why.Deflection: You parry a little more often.

fight: Use Defensive Stance (level 10) and a shield. You take less damage, and enemies notice you more.
Taunt makes an enemy attack you. Use it on one that is hitting your friends.
Use Sunder Armor up to five times on the main enemy. It cuts its armor and keeps its attention.
Revenge (level 14) hits back after you block, dodge or parry. Use it when it lights up.
Thunder Clap hits all enemies near you and makes them attack more slowly.
Last Stand gives you extra Health for a short time. Use it when you are in danger.
Shield Slam hits hard and keeps the enemy on you. Use it every time it is ready.
